name: seip
description: School Evidence Intelligence Platform. Root gate-runner + backend workspace (Sprint 1). Adding scripts arms the matching CI gate (see docs/qa/QUALITY-GATES.md).

scripts.test:security: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace apps/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test "tests/security/*.test.mjs"
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace=packages/backend-shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/auth && npm run build --workspace=packages/database
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:libs && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:libs && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
